description: This file is an administrative PHP script for managing AOP (Application Operating Procedures) settings within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes access control, configuration initialization, form handling for saving settings, and rendering an administrative UI with embedded JavaScript for dynamic form interactions.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: A class responsible for loading, handling, and saving CRM configuration settings.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A class extending Smarty templating engine functionalities for rendering the admin interface.

classes.name: Case
classes.description: A bean representing a support case, used here to access email subject macro templates.
